conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Beyond cryptocurrency, blockchain technology is used in supply chain management for tracking goods, in healthcare for secure record keeping, and even in voting systems to ensure transparency and prevent fraud. Its decentralized and immutable nature makes it valuable for any application requiring high security and trust.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
